title: Brown Noise & Rain for Sleeping - Cozy Cabin Loft | 8 Hours
description:
8 hours of deep, soft brown noise blended with gentle rain on the roof of the Stormwood Cabin loft. A warm, steady sound to cover household noise and settle a busy mind. No thunder, no music, no talking.
The sound never loops, with a gentle fade in and a slow fade out at the end. Made for sleep, focus, reading and study.
